title: About MarketLink
intro: MarketLink connects Farmers at farmers markets around Ho Chi Minh City with the people who shop there. Stalls publish what they will bring this week, you reserve from it, and you collect at the stall.
photosNote: The four photos above are placeholders.

mission.title: End the trip that comes home empty
mission.text: Stalls announce the week on a chalkboard, so the best of the morning is gone before most people arrive. MarketLink puts every stall's week in one place and holds what you reserve until you collect it.
mission.alt: Stalls at a covered market with produce stacked in wooden crates

howItWorks.title: Reserve on Thursday, collect on Saturday
howItWorks.text: Browse what four markets around Ho Chi Minh City will have this weekend and reserve from as many stalls as you like. Each stall gets its own order, its own pickup time, and is paid at the stall.
howItWorks.alt: Baskets of carrots, beans and chillies laid out on a market table

technology.title: Counts that are true the moment you order
technology.text: A reservation comes out of the stall's count straight away, so two people cannot book the same last two bunches. Pickup slots keep the queue short, and the map pins each stall inside its market.
technology.alt: Seeds and dry soil with a metal scoop

benefit.title: The stall knows what to bring
benefit.text: Farmers read the weekend orders before they harvest, so less comes back unsold. You get the pomelo you planned on, at a time you chose, paid to the person who grew it.
benefit.alt: A farmer working a flooded rice field with a small tractor

why.title: Why it exists
why.shoppers: A market morning runs on word of mouth. Stalls chalk up what they brought, regulars ask what is coming next week, and everyone else finds out by walking the rows. That works until you need something in particular, or until the trip across town ends at an empty table.
why.farmers: Farmers have the same problem from the other side. There is no easy way to tell regulars what the week will hold, to take an order before market day, or to know how much to cut on Friday evening. MarketLink writes both halves down: the stall publishes the week, you reserve from it, and the stall reads the orders before it picks.

limits.title: What MarketLink does not do
limits.payment: No online payment. You pay the Farmer at the stall when you collect. There is no card form anywhere in the product.
limits.delivery: No delivery. Every order is collected at the market, inside the window the stall sets.
limits.certification: No certification. MarketLink does not check licences or organic claims. Ask the Farmer at the stall.
limits.profiles: No separate family profiles. An account can be shared at home. The system does not tell people apart inside one account.
